note: Platform gems: one native cdylib per RubyGems platform. Versions are an owner decision; the gem version is read from ext/ukiryu_cdylib/Cargo.toml unless overridden. The container field, where present, is the image the installed gem is load-tested in (musl cannot be tested on a glibc Ruby). ruby_versions, where present, narrows the Ruby minors compiled for that platform: Windows on ARM Ruby starts at 3.4, so rb-sys-dock has no 3.2 or 3.3 for aarch64-mingw-ucrt.
